g.text: Published proxy data only; U-M observations excluded. Wing and Fricke-Wing aggregate ages are projected to CFB height using the section-specific
GTS2020 age model (no extrapolation); Fricke-Wing MAAT is phosphate-derived. MAAT/CMMT/WMMT context: literature-informed relevance-weighted
marginal Monte Carlo intervals (50/80/95%); not fitted posteriors.
Late Paleocene-early Eocene; shared CFB composite meter scale
Clarks Fork Basin stratigraphy and published climate records
